drafts.draft_en: I spent months fighting AI lipsync on my VFX shots. Mouths drifting, teeth melting, sync off by 3 frames. This is the workflow that finally fixed it, step by step below 🧵
drafts.video_tip: 10s split screen: left the old broken lipsync (label 'before'), right the fixed shot ('after'), same line of dialogue, audio on. Thread: 4 steps, one screenshot each.

drafts.draft_en: One still frame. Seedance 2.5. No compositing. This is what a single AI VFX shot looks like in 2026.
drafts.video_tip: 8-12s, your strongest cinematic VFX shot, no text overlay for the first 3s. Put the source still as the last frame so people replay. Prompt in reply 1.

drafts.draft_en: AI is incredible. I gave it one frame of Marseille's Old Port and asked for a storm rolling in from the sea. 👇
drafts.video_tip: Minimal caption, let the clip carry it: 10s wide shot, calm harbour to full storm, real location still as frame 1. Natural sound design adds a lot.

drafts.draft_en: Before / after: the raw AI render vs the final shot after my VFX pass. 80% of the magic is in the last 20%. Here's what I changed 👇
drafts.video_tip: Wipe transition before to after, 8s, then 3 quick inserts of each fix (grade, grain, light wrap). Mention the tools in reply 1 (Firefly etc.).
